title: Upgrade jspdf 3.0.1 to 4.2.1 to close critical PDF-library CVEs
context: The 2026-10-23 OSS scan found 2 critical and 7 high CVEs in jspdf 3.0.1 plus 20 findings in its dompurify 3.2.4 dependency. jspdf builds every invoice PDF (FR-01.03, FR-01.07).
decision: Bump jspdf to ^4.2.1 (dompurify 3.4.17). No source change: 4.0's only breaking change restricts file-system access in the Node build, which the browser app never uses. A regression test now pins that the stored signature is embedded.
consequences: All jspdf/dompurify findings cleared; invoice output is pixel-identical to 3.0.1; bundle slightly smaller. Adds fast-png/pako as transitive deps; drops atob/btoa.
rationale: Smallest change that removes the critical findings; verified by rendering the same invoice with both versions.
rejected: Staying on 3.x with overrides for dompurify: leaves the jspdf CVEs themselves open.
